lead: How India's Chandrayaan-3 got to the Moon and landed near the Moon's south pole in August 2023.
try: Press From launch to watch the whole journey, then Start descent to try the landing.
points: It did not fly straight there. It raised its orbit around Earth step by step to save fuel.
Near the Moon it braked to be captured, then lowered its orbit closer and closer.
The final landing took about 20 minutes of careful braking with its engines.
